spans.s:
mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
1 First, initial.
2 Chief, pre-eminent, principal.
n. (-खं)
1 The mouth.
2 The face.
3 The entrance to a house.
4

Commencement.
5

A means, an expedient.
6 Sound. []
7 The opening division of a drama, the first act, &c.
8 The previous or preparatory incidents of a drama.
9 The Vedas scripture.
m. (-खः)
The beak of a bird.
E.
खन to dig, Uṇādi aff. अच् with the power of ड, by which the final is rejected, मुट् initial augment.

m. (-कः)
An onion.
E.
मुख the mouth, and गन्धक scenting.

f. (-ण्टा)
Howling, uttering a particular cry of grief, &c.
E.
मुस्व the mouth, and घण्टा a bell.

f. (-ला)
A species of the Āryā metre.

f. (-री)
The tongue.
E.
मुख the mouth, and चीरी the cry or chirp of the cricket, or a cricket.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Derived or proceeding from the mouth, born in the mouth, &c.
m. (-जः)
1 A Brahman, born from the mouth of

BRAHMĀ.
2

A tooth.
E.
मुख the mouth, and ज born.

ind.
From the mouth.
E.
मुख, and तसि aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating or pertaining to the mouth.
E.
मुलतस् as above, and छ aff.

m. (-णः)
The onion.
E.
मुख the mouth, and टूषण fouling.

f. (-ता)
A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)
E.
मुख the mouth, and धौत cleansed, (by it.)

f. (-नी)
The goddess SARASVATĪ.
E.
मुख the mouth, and निवासिनी abiding; as the goddess of speech, &c.

m. (-कः)
An idler, a lazy man.
E.
मुख the face, निरीक्षक contemplating.

n. (-णं)
1 A mouthful of water for rinsing the mouth
2 A mouthful.
3 Filling the mouth.
E.
मुख the mouth, and पूरण filling.

n. (-णं)
Betel, the leaf of the piper betel eaten with the Areca nut, catechu, caustic lime, &c.
E.
मुख the mouth, and भूषण an ornament.

m. (-चः)
A beggar, a petitioner.
E.
मुख the mouth, and पच who ripens, (his purpose,) from पच with खच् aff.

n. (-णं)
The bit of a bridle.
E.
मुख the mouth, and यन्त्रण restraining.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Foul-mouthed, speaking harshly or scurrilously.
2 Sounding, noisy.
3 Speaking in ridicule of, rallying, mocking, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 A leader.
2 A conch shell.
3 Leading, preceding.
4 A crow.
E.
मुख the mouth, and र aff. implying depreciation, or रा to go, ड aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounding, ringing, making a noise.
E.
मुखर, and इतच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Rallying, mocking.
E.
मुखर, and करण making, च्चि augment.

m. (-लः)
A hog.
E.
मुख the mouth, and लाङ्गल a plough.

n. (-द्यं)
1 A musical instrument played with the mouth, a jew's harp(?)
2 Making a noise with the mouth by striking it with the hand, playing on the mouth.
E.
मुख the mouth. and वाद्य a musical instrument.

m. (-नः)
A perfume for the mouth, any drug, as camphor or orris-root so used, or a composition usually taken in the form of a pill.
E.
मुख the mouth, and वासन perfuming.

f. (-का)
A she-goat.

f. (-ष्ठा)
A cockroach.
E.
मुख the mouth, and विष्ठा fæces.

n. (-नं)
Opening the mouth wide.
E.
मुख, with वि and आङ् prefixed to दा to give, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-फः-फा-फं)
Foul-mouthed, scurrilous.
E.
मुख the mouth, and शफ a hoof.

m. (-नः)
Pungency, sharp or pungent flavour
n. (-नं)
Cleaning the mouth.
E.
मुख the mouth, and शोधन cleansing.

m. (-धी)
The lime or citron.
E.
मुख the mouth, and शोधिन् what cleanses.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Foul-mouthed, scurrilous.

m. (-वः)
A Brahman.
E.
मुख the mouth, (of BRAHMĀ,) and सम्भव born.

n. (-रं)
The moisture of the lips.
E.
मुख the mouth, and सुरा spirituous liquor, टच् aff.

m. (-वः)
Spittle, saliva.
E.
मुख the mouth, स्रु to drop, aff. अण्.

m. (-ग्निः)
1 The conflagration of a forest.
2 A sort of goblin with a face of fire.
3 Fire put into the mouth of the corpse at the time of lighting the funeral pile.
4 A sacrificial or consecrated fire.
E.
मुच mouth, face, or chief, principal, and अग्नि fire.

m. (-स्त्रः)
A crab.
E.
मुख the mouth, and अस्त्र a weapon.

f. (-ल्का)
Fire in a forest.
E.
मुख face or mouth, and उल्का flame.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
Chief, primary, principal.
n. (-ख्यं)
1 A principal or essential rite or ordinance.
2 Reading or teaching the

Vedas.
3

The month when reckoned from new moon to new moon.
E.
मुख chief, य aff.

f. (-ता)
Pre-eminence, being best or chief.
E.
मुख्य, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, मुख्यत्वं.

ind.
Principally, particularly.
E.
मुख्य, and शसि aff.
